Discard a draft while retaining its fingerprint to prevent duplicate capture.

Create a new loan with full amortization schedule.

get.summary: List all loans of the authenticated user.
Get loan details including complete installments schedule and payment history.

get.summary: List active budgets evaluated against actual monthly spending from the Ledger.

put.summary: Edit an active recurrent budget's limit and alert fraction without recreating it.
put.description: Both limitAmount and alertThreshold are required. Amount is in the existing currency; alertThreshold is a fraction (0 < value <= 1, e.g. 0.80 = 80%). Preserves owner, category, currency, period, ID, creation time and active state. Missing, foreign and inactive budgets return 404; invalid values return 400 without mutation. Does not create historical monthly versions.

post.summary: Register an investment or asset with its current value.

put.summary: Record a new valuation; variation is recalculated from history.

post.summary: Register an account-affecting investment contribution or disposal without changing valuation.
Reverse a linked investment cash movement atomically while retaining its audit link.

delete.summary: Archive an investment without deleting linked cash history.

put.summary: Create or replace the user's income distribution plan.

post.summary: Generate an income distribution proposal based on 50/30/20 guideline and active debt obligations (BUD-05).

Webhook endpoint for inbound WhatsApp messages (BOT-02 to BOT-09). Strictly replies to incoming messages.

trackingMode.description: Expenses tracks assigned category expenses. TargetOnly is an allocation target without contribution tracking and requires no assigned categories. Omission defaults to Expenses; explicit null and other values are rejected.

limitAmount.description: Required non-null limit in the budget's existing currency units (e.g. 275.55 BOB), rounded to that currency's precision; must remain strictly positive after rounding. Currency cannot be changed.

alertThreshold.description: Required non-null alert fraction greater than 0 and at most 1; 0.80 means 80%, 1 means 100% (not 80 or 100).
